references.text: The context where Joshua asks the sun to stand still, leading to the unique day described in verse 14
The Lord will fight for you, and you shall be silent - the same theme of God fighting for Israel
The Lord your God goes before you and will fight for you - the promise that God fights for His people
The Lord your God goes with you to fight for you against your enemies and give you victory
The sun's disk moved back ten steps - another example of God intervening in the course of nature
From heaven the stars fought against Sisera - God uses heavenly bodies in battle for Israel
The Lord sent thunder against the Philistines and confused them - God fights supernaturally for Israel
The battle is not yours, but God's - the same theme that the Lord fights for His people
